actions.name: HubSpot CRM Assistant - Message Handler
actions.description: Route each incoming chat message to the HubSpot CRM Agentic Worker (dw.agent) and reply with its answer

files.content:
pack_id: agentic-hubspot-crm-demo
version: 0.1.0
kind: application
publisher: Greentic
components: []
dependencies: []
flows:
- id: on_message
  file: flows/on_message.ygtc
  tags:
  - default
  entrypoints:
  - default
agents:
  hubspot_assistant:
    agent_id: hubspot_assistant
    system_prompt: "You are a HubSpot CRM assistant running as an Agentic Worker inside a Greentic flow. You help a sales and customer-success team manage their HubSpot CRM: contacts, deals, companies, and support tickets. Use hubspot_contacts, hubspot_deals, hubspot_companies, and hubspot_tickets (each takes an operation of create, search, update, or get) and hubspot_associate to link two records. Always search before creating a record to avoid duplicates. CREATING A CONTACT: when the user wants to create a contact, do NOT call any tool and do NOT create it yet. Instead reply with one short sentence asking them to review the details in the form, and end your reply with the exact marker [[CREATE_CONTACT]]. A form will then collect and confirm the contact fields before anything is written. For creating deals, companies, or tickets, and for all updates or associations, confirm with the user in chat before changing data. After any create or update, report the record id and its HubSpot URL. Always respond in English only - every reply, including greetings, must be written in English, even if the user writes to you in another language. Never invent record ids, properties, or results - only report what the tools return."
    tools:
      - extension_id: greentic.hubspot
        tool_name: hubspot_contacts
      - extension_id: greentic.hubspot
        tool_name: hubspot_deals
      - extension_id: greentic.hubspot
        tool_name: hubspot_companies
      - extension_id: greentic.hubspot
        tool_name: hubspot_tickets
      - extension_id: greentic.hubspot
        tool_name: hubspot_associate
    guardrails: []
    llm:
      provider: deepseek
      model: deepseek-chat
      credential_ref: deepseek
    limits:
      max_iter: 8
      timeout: 120

id: default
title: HubSpot CRM Assistant - Message Handler
description: Chat with the HubSpot CRM Agentic Worker; creating a contact is confirmed via an Adaptive Card form before it is written
type: messaging
start: assistant

nodes:
  # Chat agent (dw.agent). Three exits, checked in order:
  #  1. an Adaptive Card submit re-enters the flow here; response.action carries
  #     the form's action, so a confirmed create routes straight to do_create.
  #  2. a create-contact intent makes the agent emit the [[CREATE_CONTACT]] marker
  #     (it does NOT write) so we show the confirm form instead.
  #  3. everything else is a normal chat reply.
  assistant:
    dw.agent:
      user_text: "{{in.input.text}}"
    operation: hubspot_assistant
    routing:
      - condition: response.action == create_contact_submit
        to: do_create
      - condition: reply contains [[CREATE_CONTACT]]
        to: show_create_card
      - to: send_reply

  # Send the Adaptive Card create/confirm form inline (no card component needed).
  # Action.Submit returns the fields as response.* / metadata and action=
  # create_contact_submit, re-entering the flow at assistant.
  show_create_card:
    emit.response:
      messages:
        - type: adaptive_card
          card:
            $schema: "http://adaptivecards.io/schemas/adaptive-card.json"
            type: AdaptiveCard
            version: "1.5"
            body:
              - type: TextBlock
                text: "Create a new HubSpot contact"
                weight: Bolder
                size: Large
              - type: TextBlock
                text: "Review and complete the details below, then click Create."
                wrap: true
                isSubtle: true
              - type: Input.Text
                id: firstname
                label: "First name"
                placeholder: "Jane"
              - type: Input.Text
                id: lastname
                label: "Last name"
                placeholder: "Doe"
              - type: Input.Text
                id: email
                label: "Email"
                placeholder: "jane@example.com"
                style: Email
              - type: Input.Text
                id: phone
                label: "Phone"
                placeholder: "+1 555 0100"
                style: Tel
              - type: Input.Text
                id: company
                label: "Company"
                placeholder: "Acme Inc."
            actions:
              - type: Action.Submit
                title: "Create contact"
                style: positive
                data:
                  action: create_contact_submit
              - type: Action.Submit
                title: "Cancel"
                data:
                  action: cancel_create
    routing:
      - out: true

  # Confirmed create: hand the submitted fields to the agent to call hubspot_contacts create.
  do_create:
    dw.agent:
      user_text: "The user confirmed creating a contact via the form. Create it now: call hubspot_contacts with operation create and these properties - firstname={{in.input.metadata.firstname}}, lastname={{in.input.metadata.lastname}}, email={{in.input.metadata.email}}, phone={{in.input.metadata.phone}}, company={{in.input.metadata.company}}. Then report the new contact id and its HubSpot URL. Do not ask for confirmation again."
    operation: hubspot_assistant
    routing:
      - to: send_create_reply

  send_reply:
    emit.response:
      messages:
        - type: text
          text: "{{node.assistant.reply}}"
    routing:
      - out: true

  send_create_reply:
    emit.response:
      messages:
        - type: text
          text: "{{node.do_create.reply}}"
    routing:
      - out: true

provider_id: agentic-hubspot-crm-demo
version: 1
title: HubSpot CRM Assistant — credentials
description: API keys for the agentic worker and its HubSpot CRM tools.
questions:
  - name: deepseek
    title: DeepSeek API key
    kind: string
    required: true
    secret: true
    help: "LLM API key for the agentic worker's reasoning loop (https://platform.deepseek.com)."
    group: LLM
    docs_url: "https://platform.deepseek.com"
    placeholder: "sk-..."
  - name: access_token
    title: HubSpot Private App token
    kind: string
    required: true
    secret: true
    help: "HubSpot Private App access token used by the hubspot_* tools (https://developers.hubspot.com/docs/api/private-apps)."
    group: Tools
    docs_url: "https://developers.hubspot.com/docs/api/private-apps"
    placeholder: "pat-..."
